deskyard volume create: create a volume

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] volume create NAME

Creates a volume, volume/NAME/ in the server's data folder; an existing folder
of that name is kept as it is. Grant it to computers with `deskyard computer
create … --volume NAME`.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  volume name (2–32 lowercase letters, digits and -)

Options:
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard volume create photos

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
